properties.name: jwt.secret
properties.description: Base64 or raw secret key used for signing JWT tokens.

properties.name: jwt.expiration
properties.description: Access token expiration duration in milliseconds.

properties.name: jwt.refresh-expiration
properties.description: Refresh token expiration duration in milliseconds.

properties.description: API Key for PayOS payment gateway integration.

properties.description: Comma-separated list of allowed origins for Cross-Origin Resource Sharing (CORS).
